entries.desc: From the story worktree for a REVIEW story with a valid git HEAD and materialHash, review_run_start succeeds, prints Review run B-3787:RR-001 started for the requested reviewer lane, persists reviewer-run metadata with the real worktree HEAD/materialHash, and does not report any workspace diagnostic.

evidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:field-regression-cli-smoke
evidence.note: Build passed and field-regression smoke asserted REVIEW review_run_start success persists real headHash/materialHash and stable reviewRunId.

entries.desc: When the workspace lacks a usable signed snapshot source such as non-git directory, unborn HEAD, or missing materialHash, review_run_start exits nonzero with a precise diagnostic and concrete next action, and creates no reviewer run metadata or currentReviewRound repair write.

evidence.note: Smoke covers non-git and unborn HEAD review_run_start failures and asserts no currentReviewRound repair or review-runs write occurs before snapshot readiness.

entries.desc: The workspace resolver validates that the canonical ctx.root used for story metadata is the same canonical worktree root used for HEAD/materialHash capture; a mismatch is rejected before snapshot capture or metadata mutation.

evidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:field-regression-cli-smoke
evidence.note: resolveStoryCommandWorkspace now canonicalizes ctx.root versus expected worktree root; smoke asserts mismatched LATTICE_PROJECT_ROOT fails before writes.

entries.desc: If process.cwd is the story worktree but the caller passes a root that points at main or another checkout, review_run_start fails closed with a root/worktree mismatch diagnostic and leaves the story file, currentReviewRound, and review-runs collection unchanged.

evidence.note: Smoke runs from story worktree with LATTICE_PROJECT_ROOT pointing at main and asserts root/worktree mismatch plus no reviewer-run write.

entries.desc: A stale, placeholder, or otherwise unavailable materialHash cannot be signed into a reviewer run; the handler refuses to create local REVIEW evidence unless HEAD and materialHash are captured from the same verified workspace root.

evidence.note: diagnoseReviewRunSnapshot refuses missing git HEAD/materialHash before signing; placeholder user hashes are still not accepted for reviewer runs.

entries.desc: Regression coverage exercises direct REVIEW review_run_start in a git-backed story worktree and asserts the visible success line, stable reviewRunId, persisted run metadata, real HEAD hash, and non-empty materialHash are all present.

evidence.note: Field regression smoke covers direct REVIEW review_run_start success, reviewRunId output, persisted run metadata, headHash, and materialHash.

entries.desc: Regression coverage proves legacy REVIEW stories missing currentReviewRound are repaired only after snapshot readiness succeeds; non-git, no-commit, and missing-materialHash cases fail without currentReviewRound or review-run writes.

evidence.note: Field regression smoke proves legacy REVIEW currentReviewRound repair happens only after snapshot readiness; non-git and no-commit cases leave story and review-runs unchanged.

entries.desc: Regression coverage includes wrong worktree and ctx.root/worktree mismatch cases, plus review_loop placeholder and empty-trigger preservation, so diagnostics do not regress unrelated REVIEW entry behavior.

evidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:field-regression-cli-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:review-loop-smoke
evidence.note: Field regression covers wrong cwd and ctx.root/worktree mismatch; review-loop smoke confirms placeholder rollback hash and empty trigger validation still pass.

entries.desc: Authority boundary smoke proves local host output, local review_run_start success text, and local reviewRunId cannot set productionDone, receiptVerified, or authorityChanged; only an Authority receipt-backed gate decision may do that.

evidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-boundary-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-gate-consumption && npm --prefix packages/main run test:baseline-local-certification-smoke
evidence.note: Authority boundary, gate-consumption, and baseline-local-certification smoke passed; local host output and local review evidence cannot set productionDone, receiptVerified, or authorityChanged.

entries.desc: Coverage asserts review_run_start diagnostics describe local signed REVIEW evidence only and never overclaim an Authority Server gate receipt, production completion, or remote approval.

evidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:field-regression-cli-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-boundary-smoke
evidence.note: review_run_start diagnostics remain local signed REVIEW evidence wording only, while Authority boundary smoke pins that no Authority Server gate receipt or production completion is inferred from local output.
